name: Hospital
description: Four-storey general hospital, 48 x 17 m: a dark brick ground floor under three floors of white panel cladding with long ribbon windows, an entrance canopy over a drop-off, and a helipad on the roof (raised pad with touchdown markings, edge lights, safety nets and a windsock) reached by a stair to a roof door. Inside: a double-height-glazed lobby with a reception desk, admissions and consulting rooms, an ambulance bay; on every floor wards either side of a wide corridor, a nurse station with its counter, offices, utility rooms and toilets; two stair cores and two bed lifts.
